subject: MAP: Cyclone Analytics — proposed milestones and procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Harper <daniel@cycloneanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: MAP: Cyclone Analytics — proposed milestones and procurement signature deadline

Hi Daniel —

Great to connect earlier. Quick post-call recap and a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have a single source of truth for milestones, owners, and the procurement deadline we discussed. Please review and tell me if anything below needs to shift.

High-level recommended timeline (proposed):
- Intro / scoping sign-off (Cyclone): by 2026-03-09 — owner: Daniel H.
- Security questionnaire + evidence (Cyclone red team): by 2026-03-16 — owner: Cyclone procurement/IT
- Finance / procurement review (Cyclone): by 2026-03-23 — owner: Priya Shah (procurement)
- Contract redlines & sign-off (both parties): target signature by 2026-04-09 — owners: Redwood Legal / Cyclone Legal
- Implementation kickoff (Redwood CSM + Cyclone ENG): week of 2026-04-13 (dependent on signed contract) — owner: Dev P.

Dependencies and notes:
- Cicrle: SOC 2 report and encryption attestation to be delivered alongside questionnaire (we can accept an existing SOC 2 if available).
- Redwood: draft T&C + standard SOW to be provided for review; see attached Redwood-T&C-draft.pdf.
- Target signature date is driven by Cyclone procurement needs — if that needs to move, call it out and we’ll shift the map.

Immediate asks for the Cyclone team: 1) confirm procurement contact and preferred signature deadline, 2) confirm any blackout dates for late-March approvals.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (milestones + responsibilities), Redwood-T&C-draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll iterate the MAP once you confirm targets.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Daniel Harper <daniel@cycloneanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <procurement@cycloneanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Cyclone Analytics — proposed milestones and procurement signature deadline

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick notes from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement contact is Priya Shah (copied). She’ll own the finance and purchasing timeline.
- Our legal team is asking for an internal target of 2026-04-12 for contract signature (they prefer to sign by Monday 12 Apr rather than the 9th) due to a leadership approvals window that week. Can Redwood accommodate moving the signature date to 2026-04-12?
- We’ll aim to return completed security questionnaire by 2026-03-18 (heads up: our team is slower mid-month because of a separate audit).

If you can update the MAP with the Apr 12 signature target and share a v2, that’ll help Priya track dates in our procurement system. Also, if you can call out any hard Redwood deadlines (e.g., required notice before kickoff), that would be helpful.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Daniel Harper
Head of IT & Security Operations
Cyclone Analytics
daniel@cycloneanalytics.com | +1 212-555-0112
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Harper <daniel@cycloneanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <procurement@cycloneanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:26:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Cyclone Analytics — proposed milestones and procurement signature deadline

On Tue, 3 Mar 2026 at 14:03 Daniel Harper <daniel@cycloneanalytics.com> wrote:
> Marissa —
>
> Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick notes from procurement/legal side:
>
> - Procurement contact is Priya Shah (copied). She’ll own the finance and purchasing timeline.
> - Our legal team is asking for an internal target of 2026-04-12 for contract signature (they prefer to sign by Monday 12 Apr rather than the 9th) due to a leadership approvals window that week. Can Redwood accommodate moving the signature date to 2026-04-12?
> - We’ll aim to return completed security questionnaire by 2026-03-18 (heads up: our team is slower mid-month because of a separate audit).

Thanks, Daniel — yes we can align to Apr 12. Updated notes below and attached a v2 of the MAP with that signature deadline and a brief note on Redwood hard constraints.

Updated timeline (adjusted):
- Security questionnaire + evidence: Cyclone by 2026-03-18 — owner: Cyclone IT
- Procurement review: Cyclone (Priya) by 2026-03-25 — owner: Priya S.
- Redwood to provide final T&C + revised SOW for redlines: by 2026-03-27 — owner: Marissa/Rishi
- Contract redlines complete: target 2026-04-08 — owners: both legal teams
- Signature target: 2026-04-12 — agreed (owner: Cyclone procurement + Redwood exec sign-off)
- Implementation kickoff: week of 2026-04-20 (dependent on signed contract)

Redwood constraints to flag:
- For a clean kickoff in the week of 2026-04-20 we need a fully countersigned contract no later than EOD 2026-04-12; any delay beyond that pushes kickoff by two weeks due to resource scheduling.
- Rishi, please confirm whether Redwood legal can commit to the 2026-04-08 internal redline completion target.
- Dev, can you confirm availability for an April 20 kickoff window (we may need two engineers for the first two weeks)?

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (updated milestones), Redwood-T&C-draft.pdf (same as before)

Rishi and Dev — can you acknowledge and flag any concerns? Priya / Daniel — if this looks good I’ll move the v2 into HubSpot and send a DocuSign-ready copy of the T&C + SOW once Rishi signs off on the redlines.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Daniel Harper <daniel@cycloneanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <procurement@cycloneanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Cyclone Analytics — proposed milestones and procurement signature deadline

Marissa / Rishi / Dev —

This alignment works for us. Confirming Cyclone will target 2026-04-12 for contract signature (Priya will track internally). Two quick asks: 1) please send the DocuSign link when the contract is ready, and 2) flag any clauses Redwood cannot change so our legal team is aware before redlines.

On the resource side, we’ll tentatively block the week of 2026-04-20 for kickoff; I’ll confirm exact engineers once procurement confirms the signature.

Thanks for moving fast on this — Priya, feel free to add any procurement-specific fields we should capture in the MAP.

Best,
Daniel
(Attachments referenced in thread: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx; MAP-draft-v2.xlsx; Redwood-T&C-draft.pdf)
